def factor_tail_drawdown_depth(df):
    """Tail-risk exposure via maximum adverse drawdown depth relative to a trailing high."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    rolling_max = df_copy["close"].rolling(60, min_periods=20).max()
    drawdown = df_copy["close"] / rolling_max - 1.0
    tail_depth = drawdown.rolling(20, min_periods=5).min()
    factor = -tail_depth
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    return pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_tail_drawdown_depth")
description: Measures tail-risk exposure as the maximum adverse price excursion from a 60-day rolling high observed within the last 20 days. A deep drawdown indicates accumulated fragility and stress, producing a positive signal when the worst recent drawdown is severe. This is a distinct price-path stress mechanism, not a smoothing or rank variant.
